overview_description.description:
Upcall helps hundreds of companies acquire, qualify, engage and retain more customers through outbound phone calls.

Upcall's platform and API give 24/7 access to 1000s vetted US based callers as well as various tools to manage call campaigns effectively such as script templates, call analytics and recording, as well as integrations with client's existing workflow (Slack, Salesforce, Google Calendar, Outlook, ...).


Upcall was part of the prestigious Y Combinator.

product.name: Omnichannel Sales Outreach Platform
product.description: A platform that uses human agents to conduct outbound sales and marketing outreach via phone calls, emails, and SMS to engage leads and generate sales opportunities.

identifier.value: Appointment Reminder, Scheduling and Confirmation Services

product.name: Appointment Reminder, Scheduling and Confirmation Services
product.description: A service that manages appointment scheduling and confirmation calls to reduce missed appointments and keep client calendars updated.

product.name: Appointment Setting Service
product.description: A service that schedules meetings and sales appointments by engaging B2B leads through trained U.S.-based appointment setters.

product.name: B2B Cold Calling Service
product.description: A cold calling service that uses top U.S.-based sales development representatives to generate leads and convert prospects into sales opportunities.

identifier.value: Customer Retention and Loyalty Phone Calls

product.name: Customer Retention and Loyalty Phone Calls
product.description: A service that conducts outbound calls to engage existing customers, aiming to improve retention and loyalty through regular communication.

product.name: Customer and User Feedback Call Center
